messages:
alex_sales: Quick sync — Prospect (EdgeBank) sent an RFI and wants a 2-week POC. They asked for our capability matrix, security questionnaire answers, and pricing for both hosted and a short Dedicated POC. Can we assemble and confirm ownership?

maria_se: I can update the capability matrix (model support, latency SLOs, quantization options). Will need confirm on which models + sample latency numbers. :memo:

jamie_so: POC pricing question — do we offer free POC credits or a discounted reserved week for Dedicated? Need $ guidance for procurement.

alex_sales: Ideally: hosted = free credits + usage-based for >free; Dedicated = short-term reserved at ~50% off list for first month. Is that ok from finance? :thinking_face:

jamie_so: That matches previous deals — we did a 30–50% POC concession. I'll flag for formal approval but ok to propose in RFI.

security_team: We have the security questionnaire draft ready. Missing a couple of items: (1) network architecture diagram for the POC, (2) retention/ingestion/dataflow details, (3) proof of SOC2 report hyperlink. We can provide templates.

alex_sales: Who can fill the network diagram? Prospect expects VPC connectivity details and whether we support private endpoints.

maria_se: I can draft the diagram. For Dedicated POC we expose a customer VPC peering + optional private endpoints. For Hosted we recommend a secure ingestion path with envelope encryption.

infra_bot: Note: account quotas may block a Dedicated POC in us-east-1 for the next 48h — request a capacity hold now to be safe. Command: `request-capacity --region us-east-1 --type dedicated --gpu a100 --hours 336`

jamie_so: Also need a short runbook for the POC: acceptance criteria, test prompts, latency/cost targets, who to ping on-call. I can draft the runbook if someone shares the eval prompt set.

maria_se: Dropping a minimal capability matrix snippet here (will update full table in the doc):
```
Feature,Supported,Notes
Streaming,Yes,Throughput-optimized path available
KV Cache,Yes,Prefix caching reduces tokens 15–40%
Quantized Models,Yes,8-bit and 4-bit options tested
SLA,Hosted: best-effort / Dedicated: 99.9% uptime,SLA addendum available for Dedicated
```

alex_sales: Perfect. @security_team — can you attach SOC2 link and confirm the questionnaire items by COB today? Procurement wants the documents in the RFI package by tomorrow morning. :alarm_clock:

security_team: Will attach SOC2 and encryption whitepaper. One ask: need to confirm if customer PII will be routed through our logging pipeline during the POC. If not, we should disable access and mention that in the questionnaire.

maria_se: We can disable logging for the POC and provide a config snippet: 
```yaml
logging:
  enabled: false
  retention_days: 0
```

jamie_so: For sales language on pricing in RFI: propose two tracks — Hosted POC (free credits + paid overage at standard list), Dedicated Short POC (1-week reserved, 50% off list, refundable up to start date). Also include estimated cost range: Hosted ~= $200–2k (depends on tokens), Dedicated short ~= $3k–8k depending on GPU config.

alex_sales: Good. I'll assemble the RFI package: capability matrix (maria), security questionnaire (security_team), pricing summary (jamie) + POC runbook (jamie) + network diagram (maria). Can everyone respond with their draft links in this thread when ready?

maria_se: Draft matrix uploaded: https://redwood-docs.internal/edgebank/rfi/capability-matrix-v0.2 :eyes:

security_team: Uploaded SOC2 and questionnaire answers: https://redwood-sec.internal/edgebank/soc2-and-rfi-answers

jamie_so: Draft pricing + runbook uploaded here: https://redwood-sales.internal/edgebank/poc-pricing-runbook-v1

alex_sales: Thanks team — I'll package and send to EdgeBank by 09:00 PT tomorrow. If anything material changes, ping me and I'll delay send. :thumbsup:

infra_bot: Capacity hold confirmed for us-east-1 (dedicated). Expiry: 2026-03-25T04:00:00Z.

jamie_so: Quick checklist before send: final signoffs from security, finance (pricing), and SE on acceptance criteria. Who has final signoff for SE?

maria_se: I can sign off on SE acceptance criteria after one pass of the runbook tests.

alex_sales: OK — final action items: security confirm COB, finance confirm discount offer, SE (maria) signoff after runbook smoke test. Closing loop tomorrow AM.

(Reaction summary: :thumbsup: from jamie_so, :eyes: from alex_sales)
